jobs.title: Senior People Program Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.


JOB INTRODUCTION

 Tekion is entering its next phase of growth and is looking for a People Program Manager to support day-to-day People Program operations and help scale the infrastructure that powers our employee experience in India. 

 This is an individual contributor role focused on strong execution, program ownership, and operational excellence. You will partner closely with People Operations, People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Legal/Privacy, and Systems teams to deliver consistent, compliant, and employee centric People programs. For globally owned People programs, this role will serve as the India execution lead, responsible for localizing requirements, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring successful delivery and adoption in India. 




KEY ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own and execute People programs end-to-end including performance management cycles, engagement surveys, internal talent movement programs, People/HR system upgrades, and compliance related initiatives. 

 - Manage project delivery by building and maintaining project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and status updates; proactively identify risks and drive mitigation. 

 - Operationalize programs by supporting governance, operating rhythms, documentation, and handoffs to ensure programs are sustainable beyond initial launch. 

 - Drive standardization and continuous improvement by maintaining core program artifacts (project charter, RACI, project plan, comms plan, launch readiness checklist, building repeatable playbooks/SOPs, and running post-launch retros to capture learnings and improve future cycles. 

 - Create clear, scalable resources such as process guides, FAQs, templates, and manager communications to enable self-service and consistent execution. 

 - Partner with Legal/Privacy and India compliance experts to ensure programs align with local statutory, audit, and data privacy requirements. 

 - Maintain and analyze People data, including reporting, data audits, and basic dashboards to track program health and identify improvement opportunities. 

 - Support the People team’s operating cadence, including preparation for Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews and readiness for peak People cycles. 

What success looks like in this role 

 - Core People programs and cycles run smoothly, on time, and with minimal escalations. 

 - Stakeholders have clear visibility into timelines, ownership, and expectations for People & Cross-functional programs. 

 - Processes and documentation are clear enough to enable consistent execution and increased self-service 

 - The People team can rely on this role for strong operational follow-through and program readiness. 

 About you 

 - A strong executor who brings structure to ambiguity and reliably follows through on commitments. 

 - A process-oriented thinker who looks for practical improvements on that scale. 

 - A collaborative partner who communicates clearly with cross functional stakeholders and balances people's needs with business priorities. 

 - Detail oriented and organized with the confidence to raise risks and push back when needed. 
   
   


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 

 - 4–6 years of experience in HR/People Programs, HR/People Operations, HR/People Project Management, or related roles, ideally in a fast growing or mid to large organization. 

 - Hands-on experience delivering cross-functional projects or recurring cycles (e.g., performance reviews, engagement surveys, system rollouts). 

 - Working knowledge of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Microsoft Planner, Asana) and strong documentation practices. 

 - Solid Excel or Google Sheets skills for reporting, tracking, and basic analysis of HR data. 

 - Experience working with vendors or internal service providers to track deliverables and timelines. 

 - Comfort collaborating with global stakeholders across time zones, including India–US teams. 
   
   


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Exposure to India compliance topics (e.g., statutory processes, audits) through partnership with subject matter experts 

 - Experience with People systems such as Workday (or equivalent HRIS), Greenhouse or Ashby (ATS), or similar tools. 

 - Formal project management training or certification (PMP, Prince2, or equivalent). 
   
   


PERKS & BENEFITS 

 - Opportunity to work with some of the smartest minds to solve complex challenges at scale. 

 - Impactful role in shaping and securing a global, cloud-native & AI driven platform. 

 - Innovative, collaborative, and fast-paced culture.

jobs.title: Finance Operations Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

We are seeking a Finance Operations Lead to oversee our SaaS billing, Accounts Receivable (AR), and subscription revenue recognition. You will lead financial operations and play a critical role in optimizing our ERP infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in ERP implementations and complex SaaS billing models, with NetSuite experience being a major advantage.
Key Responsibilities
SaaS Revenue & Billing Operations

 - Manage the end-to-end SaaS billing cycle, including new subscriptions, renewals, upsells, and mid-term upgrades.

 - Oversee deferred revenue and SaaS revenue recognition compliance under ASC 606 / IFRS 15 frameworks.

 - Manage automated subscription billing schedules, usage-based metrics, and multi-tier pricing structures.

 - Monitor AR aging reports, manage churn risk, and drive dunning and collections workflows.

 - Reconcile SaaS metrics (MRR, ARR, LTV) with core accounting ledgers during month-end close.

ERP Implementation & System Integration

 - Lead or support the implementation, testing, and deployment of SaaS-specific ERP modules.

 - Migrate legacy customer subscriptions and historical financial data into the new system.

 - Integrate NetSuite/ERP with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and specialized subscription billing engines.

 - Map quote-to-cash workflows to maximize automated invoicing and minimize manual calculations.

 - Establish system documentation and train the finance team on new ERP processes.

Team Leadership & Process Optimization

 - Supervise, mentor, and scale a lean team of billing and revenue specialists.

 - Identify bottlenecks in the cash-collection cycle and automate recurring payment workflows.

 - Provide data-driven insights on billing anomalies, credit memos, and bad debt reserves.

Qualifications and Skills
Education & Experience

 - Experience: 8+ years of experience in finance operations, specifically within the SaaS or subscription tech industry.

 - Qualification: Graduation completion, Chartered Accountant (CA) or Semi-Qualified CA preferred.

 - ERP Expertise: Mandatory hands-on experience driving or supporting an ERP implementation.

 - System Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (especially Advanced Revenue Management / SuiteBilling) is a distinct advantage.

Core Competencies

 - Deep knowledge of SaaS billing metrics, revenue deferrals, and contract modifications.

 - Advanced Excel skills for manipulating large data sets during system migrations.

 - Strong project management abilities to meet strict implementation timelines.

jobs.description:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.


JOB INTRODUCTION:

The Senior Manager, FP&A leads financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting activities across multiple business units or corporate functions. Provides executive-level financial insights and partners with leadership to support strategic decision-making. Manages a team of analysts and drives improvements in planning tools, processes, and reporting.



KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Oversees annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long-range planning cycles for assigned functions or business lines.

 - Provides financial analysis and recommendations to executive leadership, including scenario modeling and strategic insights.

 - Develops and maintains financial dashboards and performance metrics aligned with company goals.

 - Leads cross-functional financial reviews and drives alignment between financial results and business strategy.

 - Ensures timely and accurate financial reporting, variance analysis, and commentary for leadership and board reporting.

 - Implements planning tools and process enhancements to scale FP&A capabilities and improve forecast accuracy.

 - Manages and mentors a team of finance analysts and managers, supporting career development and performance excellence.



BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10+ years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or strategic business analysis

 - Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field; MBA or CFA strongly preferred

 - Proven experience managing financial planning cycles and delivering actionable business insights

 - Strong proficiency in Excel, financial modeling, and planning/reporting tools (e.g., Anaplan, Adaptive Insights, Power BI)

 - Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP, or NetSuite

 - Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills

 


PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation and generous stock options    

 - 100% employer-paid top-of-the-line medical, dental and vision coverage   

 - Great benefits including unlimited PTO, parental leave and free snacks and beverages  

 - The opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley’s most dominant and successful companies   

 - Be part of an early stage, hyper-growth start-up with the opportunity to grow and prosper     

 - Work on the latest and coolest technologies – everything is home-grown and built ground-up    

 - A dynamic work environment with a strong sense of community and collaboration    

 - The open and transparent culture that encourages innovation, rewards performance and discourages hierarchy    

 - Exciting opportunities for career growth and development
